test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following novels is NOT written by the famous Hindi writer Premchand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashi ka Assi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Premchand**

 
 
• **Premchand**, also known as **Dhanpat Rai Srivastava, was an Indian author best known for his contemporary Hindustani writing**.
 
• He was born on **July 31, 1880**, and died on **October 8, 1936**.
 
• **Hindi and Urdu social fiction** were invented by Premchand.
 
• He was one of the **first writers to discuss caste systems, the suffering of working women, and other issues that were prevalent in late 1880s culture**.
 
• He is one of the most well-known authors on the Indian continent and is** recognised as one of the greatest Hindi authors of the first half of the 20th century**. 
 
• He has written various novels, including, **Godaan, Karmabhoomi, Gaban, Mansarovar, and Idgah**.
 
• In a **book titled Soz-e-Watan**, he released his first collection of **five short stories**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kashi Ka Assi **

 
 
• **Kashi Nath Singh** published his first Hindi book,** Kashi Ka Assi, in 2004**.
 
• This book served as the basis for the **film Mohalla Assi**. 
 
• The** Assi** that is associated with Kashi—**either the city or the author**—is known as Kashi Ka Assi.
 
• He has incorporated **actual persons and actual dialogues into this book**.
 
• Between **1990 and 1998**, the **Ram Janmabhoomi agitation and the Mandal Commission's implementation** are covered in the story.
